studyType: Recorded sequential head-to-head audit on the two-domain 6-defect event-relay fixture

environment.executionOrder: Sequential on the same WSL2 host (Arm 1 Agy-Squad followed by Arm 2 Antigravity /teamwork control in separate fresh conversation contexts)

promptsAndConfiguration.taskObjective: Perform a read-only security, reliability, and cross-domain contract audit of benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture (gateway/, worker/, and config.json). Identify all concrete defects with file/line evidence, severity (P1/P2), root cause, and remediation.
promptsAndConfiguration.armConfiguration: Both arms audited the unmodified fixture under the same objective. Arm 1 (Agy-Squad) dispatched from benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/manifest.json (1 lead and 2 domain specialists scoped to gateway/ and worker/). Arm 2 (/teamwork control) used native /teamwork [skip-interview] orchestration.

timingBoundaries.activeWallClockSeconds: Elapsed wall-clock seconds from initial cohort or teamwork invocation to final parent completion receipt.
timingBoundaries.timeToFirstDelegationSeconds: Elapsed wall-clock seconds from initial invocation to the first child specialist spawn.

metricDefinitions.totalSteps: Total transcript step records reported by agy-context-saver check_context_health across all spawned subagents in the arm.
metricDefinitions.totalTranscriptKb: Sum of raw .system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl sizes in decimal kilobytes (1,000 B) across all spawned subagents in the arm.
metricDefinitions.parentInjectedBytes: Total UTF-8 bytes of child-to-parent wakeup messages delivered into the parent conversation context.
metricDefinitions.verifyMs: Wall-clock milliseconds for SHA-256 input and report digest verification via node mcp/handoffs.mjs verify (artifact integrity check paired with parent code and test inspection).
metricDefinitions.leftoverUntrackedFiles: Post-run git status untracked file count (secondary telemetry alongside the 3-scope teardown contract; .gitignore excludes scratch/).

provenancePolicy.conversationIds: Session conversationId UUIDs are local Antigravity conversation identifiers kept so operators can cross-check step and turn counts with agy-context-saver check_context_health.
provenancePolicy.redactionAndExclusions: Host-specific absolute paths, OS usernames, environment credentials, and raw session transcripts are excluded from published repository files.

plantedNeedles.summary: verifyWebhookSignature calls crypto.timingSafeEqual without checking buffer byte lengths, throwing an uncaught RangeError on malformed or truncated hex signatures.
plantedNeedles.adjudicationCriteria: Identify gateway/gateway.mjs:10 crypto.timingSafeEqual uncaught RangeError when actualBuf.length !== expectedBuf.length.

plantedNeedles.summary: createRateLimiter unconditionally overwrites bucket.lastRefillMs = nowMs even when intervals === 0, causing permanent token starvation under steady sub-second traffic.
plantedNeedles.adjudicationCriteria: Identify gateway/gateway.mjs:25 unconditional bucket.lastRefillMs = nowMs update starving token refill when elapsedMs < refillIntervalMs.

plantedNeedles.summary: buildWorkerEnvelope sets headers['x-idempotency-key'] while processWorkerEnvelope reads headers['x-request-id'], causing 100% of gateway envelopes to fail with MISSING_REQUEST_ID.
plantedNeedles.adjudicationCriteria: Identify header key mismatch between gateway/gateway.mjs:40 ('x-idempotency-key') and worker/worker.mjs:4 ('x-request-id').

plantedNeedles.summary: buildWorkerEnvelope emits event.schemaVersion = "2.0" while processWorkerEnvelope rejects any version other than "1.0" with UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA.
plantedNeedles.adjudicationCriteria: Identify schemaVersion mismatch between gateway/gateway.mjs:43 ('2.0') and worker/worker.mjs:9 ('1.0').

plantedNeedles.summary: processWorkerEnvelope compares millisecond delta Math.abs(nowMs - event.timestampMs) directly against config.maxSkewSeconds (300) without multiplying by 1000, shrinking the 5-minute window to 300ms.
plantedNeedles.adjudicationCriteria: Identify unit mismatch in worker/worker.mjs:12 comparing millisecond timestamp delta against config.maxSkewSeconds (300) without * 1000.

plantedNeedles.summary: readLedger swallows corrupt JSON as [] (wiping prior entries on next write), appendLedgerEntry uses non-atomic writeFileSync without locking, and processWorkerEnvelope uses attempt >= maxRetries on 1-based attempt (0 retries when maxRetries = 1).
plantedNeedles.adjudicationCriteria: Identify worker/ledger.mjs:9-21 corrupt-JSON silent reset and non-atomic write plus worker/worker.mjs:16-28 1-based attempt >= maxRetries off-by-one retry termination.

fixture.extraFindingsNote: Both arms caught 6/6 seeded defect categories. Total reported items (18 in Agy-Squad vs. 25 in Teamwork) include sub-defects split out from N6 plus secondary input-validation and hardening observations.
